title: Melbourne Parking Occupancy — parking_zones.parquet
description: Static metadata for the 536 zones, taken from the source feed unchanged except for the aggregation into zones.

zone_id.description: The city's own zone number, as it appears in the source feed.

name.description: Street plus zone number, e.g. 'Argyle Place North, zone 7001'.

street.description: Street only. Empty for 9 zones the city leaves unnamed.

latitude.description: Zone centre, averaged over the coordinates of its bays.

longitude.description: Zone centre, averaged over the coordinates of its bays.

bays.description: Sensors in the zone. Range 1-81, median 7; 69 zones have one or two bays, where occupancy takes only a few discrete values.

last_free_at.description: Last slot in which the zone reported a free bay. Lets you rebuild feed_silent for any as-of date.

feed_silent.description: True for 16 zones that reported no free bay in the last 30 days. A looser criterion, zero variance over the whole period, catches 86 zones and 16% of rows.
